subject: Fan Expo 2026 Retrospective
overview: Host Stevie B presented the final episode of 2026, thanking community members and station staff for their support following his mother's passing and sharing recaps of Fan Expo Boston and Rhode Island Comic Con.

items.title: Opening Remarks and Acknowledgements
items.summary: Stevie B opened the final show of 2026, shared reflections on the passing of his mother, and thanked friends, station staff, and supporters for their help during the past two years.

items.title: Convention Recaps and Celebrity Meetings
items.summary: Stevie B detailed attending Fan Expo Boston and Rhode Island Comic Con with Lenny Scoletta, describing interactions with celebrities such as Corey Feldman, Robbie Rist, Judith Hogue, Christopher Lloyd, Ralph Macchio, and Jeff Bergman.

items.title: Fan Expo Boston Video Footage
items.summary: The broadcast aired video footage from Fan Expo Boston 2026 showing venue sights and encounters with convention guests.

items.title: Closing Remarks and Voice Actor Tributes
items.summary: Stevie B offered tributes to voice actors who passed away during the year, expressed final thanks to his family and audience, and concluded the broadcast for 2026.
